coaching.headline: Ten lost fights decided the game: the enemy turned nine into objectives or towers, while the allied side won and cashed only two.

flags.text: Damn awful trade: second Fangtooth, then five allies dead, three to The Fey, and the offlane inner lost.
Countess: four offlane deaths before the allied offlane outer fell, zero kills, and the game's lowest hero damage.
Lt. Belica died eight times, four to The Fey, trailing 13892 gold to The Fey's 17033.
Legion's nine deaths led the game; Wraith scored four and Serath two.

focus.title: Leave the pit, then pick fights
focus.action: After an allied Fangtooth, all five leave the pit together; until The Fey, Serath and Wraith show on the map, Countess, Lt. Belica and Legion farm near allied towers instead of trading.

18.3.call: Countess fell first to Kaelen at the pit, and The Fey killed three more. With Fangtooth already secured, the call was to leave the pit together.

27.5.call: Separate plays: The Fey killed Countess in the enemy jungle, and Serath and Kaelen killed three allies in the allied half before Orb Prime fell. After four allied deaths, concede Orb Prime and hold towers.

29.3.call: Lost 0-4 in the allied half, two of the deaths to The Fey, and the enemy took Primal Fangtooth after. Regroup behind a tower before contesting a late Fangtooth.

16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3: Gold finished at 10971 against Serath's 17603, the widest lane gap on the team. When behind early, farm safely and save the burst for fights Khaimera starts.
Three deaths went to Serath and three to Kaelen, first blood to Serath included. If Kaelen is missing from the map, step back toward the tower before trading.
6a684bb5-5b04-4626-b16e-79438851da71: 21 wards, the game's most and above a 14.9 norm, plus five enemy wards cleared. Before every Fangtooth, spend the next wards on the pit entrances.
No deaths before minute ten, then six after, three to Serath. When Serath has Heresy up, stand behind Khaimera before shielding Legion.
10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a: Hell of a showing after the second Fangtooth: kills on Kaelen, Steel and Wraith in a fight lost 3-5. If allies keep falling at the pit, disengage right after scoring.
Five of eight deaths came in the allied jungle, two to The Fey and two to Kaelen. When the allied jungle must be crossed, go beside Khaimera.
Destroyed the enemy mid and offlane outer towers, two of the three allied structure takes. When the enemy groups elsewhere, push the nearest outer tower again.
3941bc24-a0e3-492f-8a89-6154da5646e9: Two deaths before minute ten, at the Fangtooth pit and on the duo lane, then seven more. If Wraith's Peekaboo! lands, back out of sniper range until the mark fades.
820 hero damage per minute against an 1100 norm, and 7.6 CS per minute against 9.6. When fights are lost early, farm the side waves to finish the build.
a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e: Six kills, the team high, with Kaelen killed twice for one death to Kaelen. When Kaelen shows on a lane, invade the enemy jungle.
Two offlane deaths, to Kaelen and then The Fey, came before the allied offlane outer fell. After one death on a lane, give up the tower instead of returning.

matchup: Serath was the lane opponent and finished 9/2 with 36455 hero damage, the most in the game.
Serath's Q, Heaven's Fury, grants CC immunity and invulnerability during the dash; hold Feast until Serath reappears.
build: Orb Of Enlightenment, the evolved Orb Of Growth, and Noxia are two of the 53.7% winning core; Lifebinder never made the build.
Timewarp, off the meta core, only speeds up non-ultimate cooldowns over time.
eternal: Vesh repeats part of ability damage on heroes as damage over time; Millennia slowly raises ultimate damage.
Vesh and Aion are a toss-up in the Countess offlane field; Vesh has the best odds.
Lich with Mind Rot is the best Vesh pair; the Lich and Millennia run ranks second.
augment: Sanguine Slash makes Blade Siphon deal more damage and heal more against isolated targets.
Shadow Echo leans ahead in the Countess offlane field; Sanguine Slash, the most played, ranks second.
crest: Tempest's Overcharge active damages up to three nearby heroes every second and heals for part of the damage.
Soulbearer and Epoch are a toss-up for the lead; Tempest ranks third of three crests with enough games.
Tempest evolves from Warlock Crest; Soulbearer and Epoch from Wizard Crest.
improvement: Lifebinder over Timewarp completes the winning core: magical lifesteal growing with missing health, giving up cooldown speed.
Shadow Echo over Sanguine Slash is the field-backed swap: repeated Shadow Slip damage on the swap, giving up isolated-target healing.

matchup: Duo was Legion and Muriel against Wraith and Steel; Wraith killed Muriel twice and Legion four times.
Steel finished 2/2/12 with 15 wards and seven enemy wards cleared, out-clearing the allied support.
build: None of the 59.1% winning core, Marshal, Crystal Tear and Windcaller, made the build.
Enra's Blessing shields a nearby allied hero only while immobilized; The Fey and Kaelen carried stuns.
Xenia shields an allied hero standing close by, with a cooldown per ally.
eternal: Exarch: healing or shielding grants attack speed and on-hit magical damage; Fervour heals nearby allies on basic attacks against heroes.
Exarch is the most played Muriel support Eternal and the only one with enough games to lead; no edge claimed.
Preservation with Fervour is the best Exarch pair; the Revelation and Fervour run, the most played, ranks fourth.
augment: Essence Nullifier makes Serenity's max-charge damage also drain mana, dealt as true damage.
Circuit Reset leans ahead in the Muriel support field; Essence Nullifier ranks third.
crest: Sanctification's Safeguard active shields the wearer and nearby heroes and grants tenacity while the shield holds.
Sanctification and Tranquility are a toss-up; Sanctification has the best odds. Sound keep.
Sanctification evolves from Warden Crest, Tranquility from Keeper Crest.
improvement: Circuit Reset over Essence Nullifier is the field-backed swap: Alacrity shields cut the ally's cooldowns, giving up the mana true damage.
Preservation over Revelation is the best-pair minor test: stronger heals and shields received, giving up cooldown cuts per cast.

matchup: The Fey was the lane opponent and finished 11/2 with 36188 hero damage and 16268 objective damage.
The Fey's R, Fly Trap, pulls attached heroes inward and stuns; spread out while the ultimate is available.
build: Combustion, Noxia and Wraith Leggings are the full 53.7% winning core.
Caustica, the last item finished, ignores part of the target's magical armor.
Wraith Leggings adds bonus ability damage against heroes at low health.
eternal: Vesh repeats part of ability damage as damage over time; Mind Rot adds a share of the target's current health.
Lotus is clearly the field's best Lt. Belica midlane Eternal; Vesh, the most played, ranks second.
The Tenth Seal with Millennia is the best Vesh pair; the Tithe of Death and Mind Rot run ranks second.
augment: Devastating Bombs makes Void Bomb deal more damage to isolated targets.
Combat Veteran leans ahead in the Lt. Belica midlane field; Devastating Bombs, the most played, ranks third.
crest: Soulbearer's Anima active grants a shield, magical lifesteal and movement speed.
Soulbearer and Epoch are a toss-up; Soulbearer has the best odds. Sound keep.
Soulbearer and Epoch evolve from Wizard Crest; Epoch's Stasis Device puts the wearer in Stasis instead.
improvement: Lotus with Early Bloom and Immaculate is the field-backed Eternal test: random stat gains, giving up Vesh's damage over time.
Combat Veteran over Devastating Bombs trades isolated-target bomb damage for movement speed and passive experience.

matchup: Wraith was the duo-lane carry opponent and finished 8/4 with 11064 objective damage against 5907 for Legion.
Wraith's Peekaboo! marks and reveals targets, and Knock, Knock! deals extra max-health damage to marked units.
build: Malady and Spear Of Desolation are two of the 57% winning core; Deathstalker never made the build.
Vanquisher executes heroes at very low health, and Infernum ignites targets after Kindling stacks build.
eternal: Weald fires true-damage missiles after damaging a low-health hero; Wind-Rider adds attack speed after a dash.
Xyris is clearly the field's best Legion carry Eternal; Weald ranks fourth of five with enough games.
Forage with Taproot is the best Weald pair; the Forage and Wind-Rider run ranks third.
augment: Press the Advantage spawns a Rally Point on takedowns, raising Legion's rate of fire and allies' attack speed.
Scorched Earth leans ahead in the Legion carry field; Press the Advantage, the most played, ranks second.
crest: Pacifier's Adrenalize dashes and empowers the next physical hit, recastable after a quick hero kill.
Ortus leans ahead of Witchstalker in the Legion carry field; Pacifier ranks third of three crests with enough games.
Pacifier evolves from Sharpshooter Crest, Ortus from Assassin Crest.
improvement: Xyris with Iron Will and Bone Collector is the field-backed Eternal test: bonus damage growing with units killed, giving up low-health missiles.
Scorched Earth over Press the Advantage adds napalm zones from mines and the ultimate, giving up takedown Rally Points.

matchup: Kaelen was the jungle opponent and finished 8/3 with 52473 objective damage, the game's most, against 11961.
Early gank kills landed on Steel and Wraith on the duo lane in the enemy half.
Kaelen's Rimefang stuns and Frostfall roots heroes in the center; Invigorate cleanses debuffs.
build: Overlord is one of the 56.5% winning core; Basilisk and Rapture never made the build.
Tainted Blade, the team's only anti-heal, cuts healing on physical damage, into Kaelen's 28023 healing, the game's most.
Void Helm increases all healing received, stacking with Draconum's healing gains from dealing damage.
eternal: Krix adds max health and size; Cannibalism adds permanent max health on takedowns.
Lotus leans ahead in the Khaimera jungle field; Krix ranks fourth of six with enough games.
Regenerative Tissue with Cannibalism is the best Krix pair; the Voracity and Cannibalism run ranks second.
augment: Jungle Invasion grants physical power in the jungle, doubled in the enemy jungle.
Feral Ambush is clearly the field's best Khaimera jungle augment; Jungle Invasion ranks second.
crest: Razorback's Echidna active raises physical and magical armor and reflects part of hero damage taken.
Razorback has too few games to lead in the Khaimera jungle field; Pacifier and Eviscerator are a toss-up.
Razorback evolves from Goliath Crest; Pacifier and Eviscerator from Sharpshooter Crest.
improvement: Feral Ambush over Jungle Invasion is the field-backed swap: longer Ambush range, giving up jungle physical power.
Lotus with Early Bloom and Prima Donna is the Eternal test: random stat gains, giving up Krix's bonus max health.

threats: Heal-stacking: Steel. Anti-heal is mandatory against this comp — we brought 1 item of it.
Dive threat on our backline: Serath. Assign peel for the carry and ward the flanks.
synergy: Our engage/CC: Countess Feast (suppress 0.75s), Lt. Belica Neural Disruptor (silence 0.5s). Our kills come from landing burst INSIDE that CC window — whoever lands it, the rest must follow up immediately.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Shadow Slip in → Eventide → Blade Siphon → Feast suppress ult, Haemorrhage true-damage
ourKits.winCondition: Feast-suppress a squishy and delete them with true-damage burst
ourKits.passive: two-ability hits apply a %max-HP true-damage bleed
ourKits.playWith: a team to clean up after her pick
ourKits.playAgainst: Feast is her whole engage — bait it / peel; she's fragile, punish the recast window

ourKits.combo: Alacrity shield+AS → Consecrated Ground bubble → Reversal global save
ourKits.winCondition: keep the carry alive with global shields and enable their damage
ourKits.passive: abilities grant Sentinel to allies; on-hit bonus
ourKits.playAgainst: she has no damage threat — dive her carry through the shields or pick her first

ourKits.combo: Seismic Assault knockup → Void Bomb → Neural Disruptor silence ult, Void Drone mana drain
ourKits.winCondition: knock up + silence a target and burst with missing-HP scaling
ourKits.playAgainst: dodge Seismic Assault; she's immobile — dive when ult is down

ourKits.combo: Ambush leap → Unleash AS → Cull stun, Invigorate to cleanse+heal
ourKits.winCondition: stick on one target, stun with Cull and out-sustain via Spirit Regen
ourKits.playWith: follow-up burst inside his Cull stun
ourKits.playAgainst: ANTI-HEAL is mandatory — it guts his whole kit; kite the leap and CC through Invigorate

enemyKits.combo: Bull Rush knockback → Force Shield wall → Shield Slam knockup+stun ult, Shield Bash %hp
enemyKits.winCondition: peel the carry with walls/knockups or engage with Shield Slam
enemyKits.playWith: a carry he can wall for and peel
enemyKits.playAgainst: his Force Shield blocks projectiles — reposition around it; bait Shield Slam

enemyKits.combo: Ascend dive → Heaven's Fury multi-strike → Chastise slow → Heresy form ult, resets on takedowns
enemyKits.winCondition: dive the backline and snowball Heresy resets
enemyKits.playWith: a frontline that creates her dive angle
enemyKits.playAgainst: peel the backline — deny the first kill and her resets dry up

enemyKits.combo: Peekaboo! mark+slow → Knock, Knock! sniper → Back It Up! displacement ult
enemyKits.winCondition: land long-range snipes on marked targets and reset on takedowns
enemyKits.playWith: engage that holds a target in his sniper line
enemyKits.playAgainst: close the gap — he's weak point-blank; dodge the skillshot snipe

enemyKits.combo: Bramble Patch slow → Harvest Nettles stacks → Untamed Growth DoT → Fly Trap pull ult
enemyKits.winCondition: Fly Trap a clumped team and detonate AoE on the pull
enemyKits.passive: takedowns spawn growths + grant move speed
enemyKits.playWith: engage that clumps for her Fly Trap
enemyKits.playAgainst: spread out vs the pull; she's squishy — dive her

18.8m: Muriel died to The Fey at the Fangtooth pit

Then they took offlane inner tower (19.2m).

checks.text: No real tank: nobody to start fights or take the first hits for the backline.
Out-tanked 0 v 2: teams two tanks down won 44.1% in 1.18.
2 divers (Countess, Khaimera): each one past the first is a hero not holding the line.
One main mage and one main marksman at most.
Muriel can stay with the carry and peel.

teamComp.summary: Draft: 0 tanks, 2 divers vs their 2 tanks, 1 diver. In 1.18 ranked, our shape won 48% and theirs 53.1%.
